Used to be good, now terrible! Don’t waste your money.
Mar 2019 • Solo
This restaurant used to be great. I used to order from them regularly on the Vietnammm app and up until the New Year, everything was satisfactory. However, both the food and the service have greatly declined in quality. It started with them not listening to instructions. I always ask for no fried onions and no peanuts, as they put those things on nearly everything at this restaurant. But lately, they’re not very good at following directions. Food has also started arriving cold, requiring heating up before eating.and during the last month, I have noticed that they’re not even putting half of the amount of veggies as they used to in their noodles. I don’t know if the chef has changed, or the manager, but this is a problem I find often in Hanoi. As soon as a business starts doing well, they reduce the quality of their service and products. You would think that they would do the opposite in order not to lose their loyal customers. But they’re all about making more profit while putting in less effort. 

Anyway, the last few times I ordered from here, food was cold, tasteless and they didn’t give much in the way of toppings on the noodles. The very last time I ordered, the delivery person couldn’t find my apartment for some reason, even though I order from here ALL THE TIME. She was being lazy and not driving far enough down the alley on her motorbike. She was just waiting at the top of the alley. We waited forever for the food and my husband was standing outside for ages, in case this girl managed to find the place. When she finally arrived after much coaching on the phone, it was the wrong food. Two totally different orders from what we had asked for. We had to call the restaurant because the delivery girl had already left. The restaurant said they’d make it right, but their idea of making it right was finally delivering what we originally ordered, two hours after we had put in the order, and ice cold. No discount or anything. Naturally, I wrote them a bad review on the vietnammm app, so they told me that they won’t deliver to me anymore. I guess their answer to “making things right” is to blacklist loyal customers who are disappointed with their declining quality of food and service, instead of actually trying to do better. 

Don’t waste your money on this place. They don’t appreciate your business and you will be disappointed. Trust me.
